10. [main.nim:10861091 / commitKnowledgeDoc] — Datacorruption error: noninjective category/slug sanitization lets distinct knowledge documents resolve to the same filesystem filename and overwrite one another.
11. [main.nim:12161246 / validateOutboundHost] — SSRF logic error: hostnames are never DNSresolved and checked before connection, so a hostname resolving to a private/loopback address passes validation.
12. [main.nim:17561762 + main.nim:36293638 / httpRequestAsync,http_fetch] — SSRF logic error: only the initial URL is validated while HTTP redirects are followed without validating each redirect destination.
13. [main.nim:1758 / httpRequestAsync] — Runtime/liveness error: the HTTP client timeout is set to 1, allowing an upstream request to hang indefinitely.
14. [main.nim:1762 / httpRequestAsync] — Runtime/memory error: response bodies are buffered without a size bound, allowing arbitrarily large upstream responses to exhaust memory.
15. [main.nim:12481265 / readBoundedBody] — Stub/deadpath error: the implemented boundedbody reader is never used, so its responsesize protection has no effect.
16. [main.nim:18631866 / parseOpenAiResponse] — Simulatedcontent error: missing token usage is replaced with fabricated token counts derived from content.len div 4.
17. [main.nim:19461972 / geminiCall] — Logic/typestate error: Gemini usage JSON is retained, but promptTokens, completionTokens, and totalTokens are never populated and remain zero.
18. [main.nim:20772085 / invokeModel] — Accounting logic error: ordinary model invocations do not call chargeTokens, so almost all LLM consumption is absent from tenant/task token accounting.
19. [main.nim:20872088 / apiKey] — Dead placeholder error: the APIkey helper is never used.
20. [main.nim:20902097 / defaultAgentKey] — Dead authenticationplaceholder error: the generated/default agent credential is never used by request authentication.
21. [main.nim:20992100 / enforcePromptBound] — Stub error: prompt bounding is explicitly a noop.
22. [main.nim:21022104 / effectiveMaxTokens] — Placeholder logic error: source is discarded and the function performs no effective tokenlimit policy.
23. [main.nim:21062112 / chargeTokens] — Budget logic error: tenant.token_budget is never read or enforced; token use is always accepted.
24. [main.nim:2121 / callChatCompletionsAsync.maxTokens] — Logic error: the callersupplied maximumtoken value is discarded.
25. [main.nim:2122 / callChatCompletionsAsync.temperature] — Logic error: the callersupplied temperature is discarded.
26. [main.nim:2123 / callChatCompletionsAsync.logprobs] — Logic error: the callersupplied logprobs request is discarded.

29. [main.nim:2126 / callChatCompletionsAsync.topP] — Logic error: the callersupplied topp value is discarded.

33. [main.nim:22732274 / haltForBudget] — Stub error: the budgethalting function explicitly does nothing.
34. [main.nim:23702407 / pruneSigma] — Dead logic error: the statepruning routine is never called, so the limits it defines for model context, queues, facts, blockers, handoffs, and subgoals are never enforced.
35. [main.nim:1386,42594262,4301 / maxSteps] — Logic error: max_steps is stored and restored but never checked during execution, so configured step limits have no effect.
36. [main.nim:16761699 / normalizePlanStep.status] — Planintegrity error: arbitrary modelsupplied string statuses are accepted instead of enforcing a valid initial status, allowing steps to arrive already "completed" or otherwise become unrunnable.
37. [main.nim:16951696 / normalizePlanStep.depends_on] — Typevalidation error: a present depends_on value of the wrong type is silently replaced by an empty dependency array instead of being rejected.
38. [main.nim:27712775 / currentPlanStep] — Typevalidation error: nonstring dependency entries become an empty ID and are silently skipped, bypassing the malformed dependency.

40. [main.nim:26462708 / routeDecisionFromJson.depends_on] — Plangraph error: initial plans are not checked for dependencies referencing nonexistent step IDs.
41. [main.nim:26462708 / routeDecisionFromJson.depends_on] — Plangraph error: initial plans are not checked for selfdependencies.
42. [main.nim:26462708 / routeDecisionFromJson.plan] — Plangraph error: initial plans are not checked for dependency cycles.
43. [main.nim:28212858 / replaceRemainingPlan] — Plangraph error: replacement plans validate IDs but do not reject selfdependencies.
44. [main.nim:28212858 / replaceRemainingPlan] — Plangraph error: replacement plans do not detect dependency cycles.
45. [main.nim:27882804 / setStepStatus] — Ambiguousplan error: duplicate IDs update only the first matching plan step, making status/progress behavior inconsistent when an initial route contains duplicates.
46. [skills/builtinllmmodels/SKILL.md:44 / graph consistency claim] — Fake/brokenreference error: the reference skill states that backend graph consistency is validated, while the backend does not validate selfdependencies or dependency cycles.
47. [main.nim:28602866 + main.nim:37243742 / ToolSpec.schema] — Fakeschema error: registered argument schemas are descriptive metadata only; tool arguments are never validated against them before handler execution.
48. [main.nim:31833193 / vm_upload_file] — Sandbox/security error: the tool accepts an arbitrary backendvisible local_path, allowing agentcontrolled reads of files outside the task workspace.
49. [main.nim:3191 / vm_upload_file] — Runtime/memory error: the entire selected backend file is loaded and base64encoded without a size limit.
50. [main.nim:31993208 / vm_download_file] — Runtime/memory error: the entire VM file is base64transferred and decoded in memory without a size limit.
51. [main.nim:32113215 / vm_download_file.name] — Pathtraversal error: the agentcontrolled output name is joined directly to the artifact directory, so ../ components can escape that directory.
52. [main.nim:31133138 / document extraction PDF path] — Fake/incompletecontent error: the tool advertises complete readable document extraction but PDF processing only extracts the PDF text layer, omitting readable image/scanned content.
53. [main.nim:3113,31403141 / document extraction DOCX path] — Fake/incompletecontent error: DOCX extraction reads only word/document.xml, omitting readable headers, footers, footnotes, endnotes, comments, and other package parts.
54. [main.nim:3113,31433152 / document extraction PPTX path] — Fake/incompletecontent error: PPTX extraction only collects slide shape text and omits readable notes and other presentation content.
55. [main.nim:3113,3155 / document extraction XLSX path] — Ambiguity/logic error: XLSX is loaded with data_only=False, returning formulas rather than cached displayed results despite the tool’s readablecontent contract.
56. [main.nim:34163421 / memory_search] — Tenantisolation error: memory search uses defaultTenantId instead of the task’s tenant ID.
57. [main.nim:34303436 / memory_write] — Tenantisolation error: memory writes use defaultTenantId instead of the task’s tenant ID.
58. [main.nim:3432 / memory_write.slug] — Pathtraversal error: the modelcontrolled slug is appended to knowledgeRoot without sandboxing or sanitization, allowing ../ traversal.
59. [main.nim:36743678 / subAgentSystem] — Promptconstruction error: subagent_core is inserted twice into every generated subagent system prompt.
60. [main.nim:36873691 / buildStepMessages] — Tenantisolation error: learned policy, skills, and knowledge are loaded from defaultTenantId instead of h.tenantId.
61. [main.nim:37243742 / executeToolAction] — Authorization error: h.allowedTools is never checked, so any registered tool can execute regardless of the task/tenant allowlist.
62. [main.nim:3753,3777 / modelStep invalidoutput path] — Runtime statemachine error: malformed model output attempts osAct > osReflect, but that transition is absent from the orchestrator graph and throws invalid orchestrator transition.
63. [main.nim:3753,3810 / modelStep toolfailure path] — Runtime statemachine error: a failed tool attempts osAct > osReflect, which is invalid in the orchestrator graph and throws before the intended failure/replan handling completes.
64. [config/prompts.yaml:39264 + main.nim:37443826 / Gemini step protocol] — Brokencontract error: the Gemini prompt requires an {"images":[...]} response while root modelStep expects action/step_complete, so valid Gemini JSON lacks the completion field needed by the root step protocol.
65. [main.nim:37663767 / Gemini modelStep fallback] — Fakesuccess error: unparseable Gemini output is fabricated into step_complete=true and treated as successful visual completion.
66. [main.nim:38263831 / modelStep] — Verification logic error: a plan step is marked completed solely from modelcontrolled step_complete=true plus tool success, with no backend verification of the step goal.
67. [main.nim:39273961 / finalizeTask] — Dead verification error: finalizeTask, the path that runs deterministic terminal verifiers and required_files checks, is never called by normal task execution.
68. [main.nim:39413955 / finalizeTask] — Verification logic error: even when deterministic terminal verification fails, a positive semantic completion response overrides it and marks the task verified=true and succeeded.
69. [main.nim:39633964 / StateTransitionEngine.execute] — Stub error: the StateTransitionEngine argument itself is discarded, so execution does not use the engine instance.
70. [main.nim:1488 / StateTransitionEngine.maxRetries] — Dead configuration error: maxRetries is initialized to 3 but never used.
71. [main.nim:4000 + main.nim:41654166 / initial system1Tick] — Deterministic runtime error: System1 runs before initial System2 routing, finds no plan step, calls completionCheck, and attempts invalid osPerceive > osValidate.
72. [main.nim:40174029 / completionCheck] — Verification logic error: complete=true is accepted without requiring a criteria array corresponding to the configured completion criteria.
73. [main.nim:40214026 / completionCheck] — Fakeverification error: when the evaluator returns complete=true, every checklist entry is forcibly rewritten to "satisfied" regardless of its individual evaluator result or evidence.
74. [main.nim:41654178 / system1Tick success path] — Verification logic error: normal successful completion directly sets verified=true and succeeded without running verifyTerminal, so configured deterministic verifiers and required files are bypassed.
75. [main.nim:41004105 / system2Think.cognition] — Typevalidation error: the promised 16number cognition vector is only padded/truncated by length; element numeric types are never validated.
76. [main.nim:42514264 / createTask.allowedTools] — Authorization logic error: new tasks receive every registered tool instead of the tenant’s persisted allowed_tools.
77. [main.nim:42734303 / restoreTask.allowedTools] — Authorization logic error: restored tasks receive every registered tool instead of restoring the tenant’s persisted allowed_tools.
78. [main.nim:1433,4268,4307 / activeTasks] — Runtime memoryleak error: terminal task handles are inserted into activeTasks but never removed.
79. [main.nim:1439,4406,4479 / activeSubAgents] — Runtime memoryleak error: terminal subagent handles are inserted into activeSubAgents but never removed.
80. [main.nim:44964591 / subAgentSupervisor] — Runtime/liveness error: the subagent loop has no iteration, time, step, or budget termination bound and can run indefinitely.
81. [main.nim:4529,4532,4556,4585 / subAgentSupervisor.messages] — Runtime/contextgrowth error: subagent conversation history grows without pruning and the entire history is repeatedly sent to the model.
82. [main.nim:45664583 / subAgentSupervisor] — Fakeverification error: modelcontrolled done=true immediately marks the subagent succeeded without backend verification of the delegated goal.
83. [main.nim:46164624 + main.nim:44984503 / stopping subagent launch] — State logic error: a persisted stopping subagent is launched and the supervisor unconditionally changes it to "running" and emits "started" before checking stopRequested.
84. [main.nim:46294637 / selectedSubAgentIds.agent_ids] — Deadlock error: explicit agent_ids are not filtered against _actor_agent_id, so a subagent can wait for itself.
85. [main.nim:46414644 / selectedSubAgentIds scope=task] — Deadlock error: task scope includes the calling subagent itself, so a subagent invoking wait_subagents with task scope waits for its own termination while blocked inside that wait.
86. [main.nim:46744695 / waitSubAgentsTool] — Runtime/liveness error: waiting has no timeout or cancellation check, so a nonterminating child can block the caller indefinitely.
87. [main.nim:48764880 / diagnosticAllowedTools] — Fake authorization error: the tenant ID is explicitly discarded and the diagnostic allowlist returns all registered tools.
88. [main.nim:48824883 / runDiagnosticRolloutCase.candidateOverride] — Simulateddiagnostic error: the candidate skill override is explicitly discarded, so the regression gate’s candidate run does not execute or evaluate the candidate being considered.
89. [main.nim:51565161 + main.nim:27002701 / routeNeedsExecution] — Deadbranch logic error: every valid route is required to contain a nonempty plan, and every nonempty plan forces execution, making the simplespecialist/direct route impossible.
90. [main.nim:5202 / directChat routed completion] — Accounting error: routed chat completions return an empty usage object instead of the model usage consumed by the task.
91. [main.nim:51955204 / directChat] — Runtime/liveness error: routed synchronous chat waits forever if the created task never reaches succeeded, failed, or halted.
92. [main.nim:5242 / streamRequestyJob] — Runtime/liveness error: streaming Requesty requests explicitly use an infinite HTTP timeout.
93. [main.nim:52485290 / streamRequestyJob SSE parser] — Streaming parser error: CRLF normalization is performed independently on each network chunk, so a \r\n pair split across chunk boundaries is not normalized and can prevent \n\n event detection.
94. [main.nim:52485290 / streamRequestyJob pending buffer] — Streaming parser error: when EOF arrives, any final SSE event remaining in pending without a trailing blankevent separator is discarded.
95. [main.nim:53385359 / runChatJob routed execution] — Runtime/liveness error: the chat job polls a routed task indefinitely with no timeout if that task never becomes terminal.
96. [main.nim:53525356 / runChatJob routed completion] — Accounting error: routed streaming chat jobs emit an empty usage object, losing the actual task/model token usage.
97. [main.nim:55565561 / authenticate] — Authentication stub error: the request is discarded and authentication always returns the default tenant.
98. [main.nim:57226054 / handleHttpRequest] — Brokenreference/security error: authenticate is never called, so all exposed API operations execute without request authentication.
99. [main.nim:55635568 / ensureDefaultTenant] — Authorization persistence error: every startup overwrites the default tenant’s saved allowed_tools with the complete tool registry.
100. [main.nim:5630 / streamChatCompletionsAsync.maxTokens] — Logic error: the client’s requested maximumtoken value is discarded.
101. [main.nim:5631 / streamChatCompletionsAsync.temperature] — Logic error: the client’s requested temperature is discarded.
102. [main.nim:5632 / streamChatCompletionsAsync.topP] — Logic error: the client’s requested topp value is discarded.
103. [main.nim:5633 / streamChatCompletionsAsync.tenantId] — Tenantisolation error: the supplied tenant ID is discarded and the generated chat job uses the global default tenant.
104. [main.nim:6111 / newAsyncHttpServer] — Runtime/resource error: maxBody=high(int) effectively removes the HTTP requestbody size limit, allowing arbitrarily large request bodies to consume server memory.
105. [main.nim:59305940 / task stop endpoint] — Stateconsistency error: stopping sets sigma.phase="terminal" but does not set h.orchestratorState=osTerminal, leaving the two representations of orchestrator state inconsistent.
106. [main.nim:59515965 / task resume endpoint] — Runtime statemachine error: resuming a halted/restored terminal task changes sigma.phase back to "perceive" but does not reset orchestratorState, leaving a restored task in osTerminal where normal routing/execution transitions cannot proceed.
107. [main.nim:59685988 / task message endpoint] — Runtime statemachine error: injecting a message clears the route and relaunches failed/halted tasks without resetting orchestratorState, so subsequent rerouting can attempt an invalid transition from the stale state.
108. [main.nim:59305940 / task stop endpoint] — Cancellation logic error: stopping the root task does not propagate a stop request to its running subagents, which can continue executing after the root is halted.
    END OF ERROR LIST.
Send back the complete code with all the fixes. Fix each of the listed errors one by one, making sure to actually correct them so that there are 0 errors remaining. Keep the original imports, since the files exist. Write out every single character; do not abbreviate anything. Fix every error. There must be exactly one file. Do not write anything else; just output the complete code, and it must not contain any comments. Never, under any circumstances, use simplified, substitute, dummy, simulated, or fake code. Write the entire file as complete, unabridged, productionready code in a single code block. It must be 100% errorfree, a complete, errorfree file, and must be submitted as a downloadable file. These requirements are mandatory and must be strictly adhered to. If no list of errors is provided, you must find all the errors and fix them. If there were comments in the original code, delete them. And most importantly: YOU MUST NEVER SIMPLIFY!
